correctness.rationale: Verify polar extremal potentials via connected tight graph rank N-c; each cluster has nonempty 0 anchors with t intermediates or 1 anchors with 1-t intermediates, giving six type patterns and (2^m-1)^3 anchors. Two-sided intermediate replacement preserves coordinate sum and strictly raises squared centered norm by 2t(1-t). Reduce maximum to Q(r) with one upper block; concavity yields nearest integers and threshold when Q(1)=Q(0). Opposite maximal facets force global radius regardless center; contact exchanges span dimension 2 below threshold or all H at/above, giving exact center dimensions. Independent graph-saturation enumeration for m=3, t=1/2,3/5,3/4,4/5 yielded 2058 vertices per case and exact contacts/ranks. Infinite m/t follow proof, not sample.
